subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Shift Left on Accessibility
description: One-minute skill: Shift Left on Accessibility.

hook.text: Accessibility issues found after launch cost 30x more to fix than issues caught during design.

buildup.text: Shifting left means integrating accessibility from requirements and design, not just testing at the end.

discovery.text: Design reviews with accessibility criteria catch layout, color, and interaction barriers before any code is written.

twist.text: A wireframe review takes 30 minutes and prevents weeks of rework after a failed accessibility audit.

climax.text: Starting accessibility at design reduces post-launch remediation by 75%. Costs drop, quality rises.

punchline.text: Start accessible. Don't retrofit. It's cheaper and better.

quiz.question: Why is shifting left on accessibility cost-effective?
options: Issues caught early cost 30x less to fix than post-launch
